blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Culture is the way things are done in a company. Every company has got its own culture: how people talk, how they dress, and how they work together.

Culture is also about values. Values are the ideas that are important for everyone. At Czarnikow, trust, respect and long-term relationships are important values.

These values are part of who we are. They help people work well together every day.

items.q: What is culture, according to the text?
options: The way things are done in a company
items.why: "Culture is the way things are done in a company."

items.q: Which values are important at Czarnikow?
items.why: "trust, respect and long-term relationships are important values."

items.q: What are values?
options: The ideas that are important for everyone
items.why: "Values are the ideas that are important for everyone."

items.q: The text suggests that culture is…
items.why: Inferência: "Every company has got its own culture" — cada empresa tem a sua, então é diferente.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: values do not help people at work
trust and respect help people work together
a company does not need values
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que os valores fazem parte de quem somos e ajudam as pessoas a trabalhar bem juntas.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie na reunião de integração. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone, and welcome to Czarnikow. My name is Sophie, and today I want to talk about our culture.

Culture is simple. It is the way we do things here. It is how we talk to each other, how we work together, and how we treat our clients. We have got a strong culture of trust. When you say something, people believe you. This is very important for us.

We have also got three big values: trust, respect and long-term relationships. Respect means we listen to every person in the room. Your voice is important, even on your first day.

Czarnikow has got a long tradition. The company is more than a hundred years old, and we work with clients for many years, not only for one deal. That is why relationships are so important.

So please, be open, ask questions, and help each other. Good culture starts with good people, and now you are part of it. Thank you, and welcome to the team.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie's job in this meeting?
options: She is welcoming new employees and talking about culture
items.why: "welcome to Czarnikow… today I want to talk about our culture."

items.q: What does Sophie say about trust?
options: Trust takes many years to start
The company has got a strong culture of trust
items.why: "We have got a strong culture of trust."

items.q: What does respect mean, according to Sophie?
options: Listening to every person in the room
items.why: "Respect means we listen to every person in the room."

items.q: Why are relationships so important at Czarnikow?
options: Because the company is very small
Because it is a new company
Because the company works with clients for many years, not only one deal
items.why: Inferência: ela diz que trabalham com clientes por muitos anos, não só um negócio — por isso as relações importam.

items.q: Sophie tells new employees that on their first day they…
options: can already speak, because their voice is important
should stay quiet and only listen
must wait one year to talk
items.why: Inferência: "Your voice is important, even on your first day" e ela pede para fazerem perguntas.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have got a strong culture of trust in our team." Trust means…
items.why: Trust = confiança: acreditar em alguém.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We listen to every person. ___ is important for us."
items.why: Respect = respeito: ouvir cada pessoa mostra respeito.

items.q: "Czarnikow has got a long tradition in commodities." A tradition is…
options: a way of doing things for a long time
items.why: Tradition = tradição: algo feito por muito tempo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Good culture is about how people work ___."
items.why: Together = juntos: cultura é sobre como as pessoas trabalham juntas.

items.q: "Our values guide our behaviour at work." Behaviour means…
items.why: Behaviour = comportamento: a maneira como as pessoas agem.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "New people need time to fit in with the team." To fit in means to…
items.why: Fit in = se enturmar, sentir-se parte do grupo.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the new values." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the culture training next month." To roll out means to…
options: start and share it with everyone
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, lançar para todos.

items.q: "At Czarnikow we get along well with our clients." To get along means to…
items.why: Get along = se dar bem, ter boa relação.

items.q: "Please reach out if you have a question." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = procurar / entrar em contato com alguém.
